# INSIDE Public Accounting

> > The leading source for CPA firm rankings, benchmarking data, and practice management insights across North America.

INSIDE Public Accounting (IPA) provides 30 years of expertise in accounting firm research, rankings, and benchmarking. The site serves CPA firm leaders with industry intelligence, quarterly insights, and comprehensive surveys on firm performance, practice management, and operational metrics.

## Key Topics

- CPA firms
- IPA 500 Rankings
- Best of the Best Awards
- Practice Management
- IPA Insights
- IPA Practice Management Survey
- Firm Performance
- Mergers & Acquisitions
- Firm Leadership
- Benchmarking Data
- Accounting Industry Trends
- Operational Efficiency
- Talent Pipeline
- Data-Driven Insights
- Professional Services

## CPA Firm Rankings & Awards

- [IPA 500 Rankings](https://insidepublicaccounting.com/ipa-top-500-firms): IPA 500 annual rankings of top CPA firms by net revenue nationwide.
- [Best of the Best Awards](https://insidepublicaccounting.com/ipa-best-of-the-best): Best of the Best awards recognizing top CPA firms in growth and profitability.

## Research & Benchmarking

- [IPA Practice Management Survey](https://insidepublicaccounting.com/about/ipa-practice-management-survey): IPA Practice Management Survey for CPA firm benchmarking and industry insights.
- [CPA Benchmarking Reports](https://insidepublicaccounting.com/about/ipa-practice-management-reports): CPA benchmarking reports on practice management, IT, HR, and administration.
- [IPA Quarterly Insights](https://insidepublicaccounting.com/about/ipa-quarterly-insights): IPA Insights quarterly reports on accounting industry trends and firm performance.

## About & Resources

- [Home](https://insidepublicaccounting.com): Homepage for IPA's CPA firm rankings, benchmarking data, and industry insights.
